description:
Here it is: https://clockwisetv.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=creator&utm_campaign=launch_nov26&utm_content=hank_video_nov17

If you're a creator and you want to be involved: leslie@clockwisetv.com 

For years people have been like, "Hank, YouTube is so messed up, why don't you start a competitor" and while a lot of folks have made things I love like Nebula and Dropout that are asking "OK, how do we do things differently" I didn't feel much need to try and make something until I started watching how YouTube works for kids. 

I don't think it's evil...but I also don't think it's designed to service families, which I think, pretty obviously, is what a kids media platform should do. 

ClockwiseTV is a media platform for 6 to 12 year olds with two major decisions baked in:

1. All of the content is curated by human parents. 
2. Every session begins with setting the stop time. It never shows a video that will go over that time and when they time is up the app closes.
